mike-customer: Hey team — after shifting ~30% of embed traffic to our Dedicated pool search started failing. Hits a client error: "dimension mismatch". Hosted embeddings used to be 1536 but responses from Dedicated are 1024.

emma: Ugh — thanks for flagging. Can you paste the exact API call and any response headers/body you got? Also which Dedicated id if visible?

mike-customer: Here's the curl we used (no explicit deployment):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-large","input":"hello world"}'
```
Body returned an embedding array but length is 1024.

raj: Quick guess: alias mapping changed on Dedicated catalog and sent you to a smaller artifact (e.g., open-embed-medium or quantized build). Check response headers — we append X-Redwood-Model and X-Deployment-ID to responses.

mike-customer: Headers I see:
```
X-Redwood-Model: open-embed-large
X-Deployment-ID: ded-42
X-Redwood-Model-Hash: b6f7e2
```
Still 1024 in `embedding.length`.

sasha: Another possibility: Dedicated runtime has a fallback transform when a kernel mismatch occurs (it can return a compressed representation). Odd edge case but has happened in the past. Can you try reproducing with batching disabled and an exact model_version?

emma: Run this exact repro and paste back headers+body:
```
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings?disable_batching=true"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..."
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-large","model_version":"open-embed-large@2025-10-12","input":"test vector"}'
```

support-bot: [automated] Ticket created: #SUP-8421 — routed to eng-ml + infra-oncall.

raj: If you share the raw JSON we return, check for a top-level `embedding_dim` or `model_info`. Hosted normally reports `embedding_dim:1536`. Dedicated sometimes exposes `embedding_dim:1024` when an alias points at a different artifact.

mike-customer: Response body (from Dedicated):
```
{
  "model": "open-embed-large",
  "embedding": [0.0001, 0.0002, ...],
  "embedding_dim": 1024
}
```

emma: Got it — we reproduced in our eu-west Dedicated staging. Alias `open-embed-large` was mapped to a quantized artifact `open-embed-large-quant` during a bad onboarding publish. That artifact was built from an older checkpoint with 1024 dims. Root cause: onboarding pipeline accepted an artifact with mismatched dims and didn't fail the publish.

sasha: Mitigation options for you: 1) Pin requests to the canonical model_version (temporary). 2) We can route your account's requests for that alias to Hosted until we fix Dedicated catalog. 3) Re-ingest the correct artifact into Dedicated (infra estimate ~2 hrs).

emma: Short steps you can take now (Mike):
- update client to include `model_version=open-embed-large@2025-10-12` (this is the verified artifact)
- optionally call with `?disable_batching=true` while we verify the runtime transform
- if you want immediate parity, we can flip a routing override for your account to Hosted for this alias

mike-customer: I'll pin model_version. Also saw a billing dip in our cost reports after the switch — will that be tracked?

emma: Yes — change in dimension affects compute/embedding unit usage. We will annotate the ticket with the time window and work with finance to reconcile any billing anomalies.

infra-oncall: Kicked off re-ingest: ingest_job_id=ingest-9901, target pool=ded-42. Validation streaming logs show artifact dim mismatch earlier; re-ingest will replace artifact and run dim check. ETA ~1.5h.

raj: Action items (internal):
- Add strict dim check to onboarding pipeline (fail publish if dims != canonical)
- Add artifact hash/uid parity check across Hosted vs Dedicated catalogs
- Admin endpoint: alias -> artifact mapping per deployment for quicker triage

mike-customer: Confirmed pinned model_version returns 1536 and search results normalized. Thanks for the fast response :thumbsup:

support-bot: [automated] Ticket #SUP-8421 updated: status=monitoring, action=customer_confirmed

emma: Leaving ticket open while infra finishes validation. We'll follow up with billing and postmortem. Reassigning to eng-ml for onboarding pipeline fix. Thanks all.
